findings.issue: Common noun מִשְׁכַּן (H4908, construct) is left as the transliteration mishkán instead of Spanish.
בַּחֹדֶשׁ is beth plus the article (in the month); al mes uses a (to/per).
בְּעֶשְׂרִים is a preposition plus a bare cardinal; el on veinte is Spanish date smoothing.

notes: The other tokens match, including both verbs, de sobre, and del testimonio.
